 TRACKING: Heavy rain later tonight 
 By David Wolter Published : Nov. 3, 2026 at 3:28 PM CST | Updated : 10 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google BOWLING GREEN, Ky. (WBKO) - Some showers are showing up tonight, but the more soaking rainfall is likely during the overnight and into Wednesday morning. 1-2″ of rainfall possible with isolated higher totals. The main concern would be ponding of water on roadways and in some poor drainage areas. A few stronger wind gusts could accompany some of these downpours. Rain will linger during the afternoon, but most of the wet weather will be east of I-65 during the second half of the day. 
 Rainfall totals of 1-2" are possible later tonight and into Wednesday (David Wolter) LOOKING AHEAD: Cooler, but dry weather is expected for the second half of the week. The coolest temperatures are likely for the weekend when highs only top out in the upper 50s. Lows drop into the lower 40s and 30s.
